mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ai_token_usage_event ( usage_event_id, user_id, feature_key, provider, model, input_tokens, cached_input_tokens, output_tokens, reasoning_tokens, total_tokens, trace_id, occurred_at ) VALUES ( #{usageEventId}, #{userId}, #{featureKey}, #{provider}, #{model}, #{inputTokens}, #{cachedInputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{reasoningTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{traceId}, #{occurredAt} )

INSERT INTO user_ai_token_usage_monthly ( user_id, usage_month, token_used ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{usageMonth}, #{tokenDelta} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE token_used = token_used + VALUES(token_used), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
